scenarios.invariant: An approval-required action cannot execute until a human approval is durably recorded.
A proposal or previously authorized run cannot exceed the agent budget.
Replaying an execution returns its original receipt without spending twice.
Reusing an idempotency key with different action input fails closed.
Emergency stop cancels executable work and constrains subsequent proposals.
An expired tool grant cannot authorize a proposal or execute an existing authorization.
Disabled and ungranted tools are denied before an agent run is created.
Every safety fixture uses only the non-external local simulator transport.
